commands.cmd:
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
VENV="$HOME/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/tools/promotion-gate-20260922/.venv"
D=$(mktemp -d) &&
timeout 60 "$VENV/bin/python3" blueprints/us-equities/data/promotion_gate.py --input blueprints/us-equities/data/fixtures/good.csv --out "$D/gate-result.json"
code=$?
timeout 30 python3 -c '
import json,hashlib,sys
r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
expect_sha=hashlib.sha256(open(sys.argv[2],"rb").read()).hexdigest()
names=sorted(c["name"] for c in r["checks"])
want=sorted(["rows_present","symbol_nonempty","valid_trading_session","open_positive","high_positive","low_positive","close_positive","volume_integral_non_negative","observed_at_not_future","high_ge_max_open_close","low_le_min_open_close","unique_symbol_session"])
ok=(r["status"]=="pass" and r["row_count"]==4 and r["input_sha256"]==expect_sha and names==want and all(c["status"]=="pass" for c in r["checks"]) and r["versions"]["pandera"]=="0.33.1")
print("gate cli on real fixture good.csv: status",r["status"],"row_count",r["row_count"],"checks_pass",sum(1 for c in r["checks"] if c["status"]=="pass"),"/",len(r["checks"]),"pandera",r["versions"]["pandera"],"input_sha256_matches",r["input_sha256"]==expect_sha)
raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)
' "$D/gate-result.json" blueprints/us-equities/data/fixtures/good.csv
rc=$?
rm -rf "$D"
test $code -eq 0 && test $rc -eq 0

gate cli on real fixture good.csv: status pass row_count 4 checks_pass 12 / 12 pandera 0.33.1 input_sha256_matches True

commands.cmd:
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
VENV="$HOME/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/tools/promotion-gate-20260922/.venv"
D=$(mktemp -d) &&
timeout 15 python3 -c '
import csv
rows=list(csv.reader(open("blueprints/us-equities/data/fixtures/good.csv")))
header,data=rows[0],rows[1:]
oi=header.index("open")
data[0][oi]="-660.1"
with open("'"$D"'/corrupted.csv","w",newline="") as f:
    w=csv.writer(f); w.writerow(header); w.writerows(data)
'
rc1=$?
timeout 30 "$VENV/bin/python3" -c '
import importlib.util, sys
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("promotion_gate", "blueprints/us-equities/data/promotion_gate.py")
g = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(g)
import pandas as pd, pandera as pandera_pkg, exchange_calendars as xcal
calendar = xcal.get_calendar("XNYS")
now = pd.Timestamp.now(tz="UTC")
schema = g._schema(calendar, now)
good = g._prepare(g._load_frame("blueprints/us-equities/data/fixtures/good.csv"))
schema.validate(good)
print("good fixture validated with no SchemaError (as expected)")
bad = g._prepare(g._load_frame("'"$D"'/corrupted.csv"))
try:
    schema.validate(bad)
    print("UNEXPECTED: no SchemaError raised on corrupted copy")
    sys.exit(1)
except pandera_pkg.errors.SchemaError as e:
    print("corrupted copy correctly rejected with", type(e).__name__, "check:", getattr(e, "check", None))
'
rc2=$?
rm -rf "$D"
test $rc1 -eq 0 && test $rc2 -eq 0
